verdict.rationale: The organization plugin is explicitly documented as managing members and teams for organization-based access control (docs-13/26), and community testimony confirms real-world use of 'organizations, multi-tenant capabilities' handled by included plugins/defaults (better-auth-comm-3). However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation detail on invitation flows, roles/permissions granularity, or team hierarchies within the organization plugin. Missing for 10: dedicated docs excerpts on invitation flow API, role/permission model detail, and independent hands-on verification of the full org+invite lifecycle.
